en.hubeali:
MuhammadBin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Bin Musa, from Giyas Bin Kaloub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar,
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>
that Ali<sup>asws</sup> disliked the Hajj and the Umra to be performed upon the camels feeding on dung’.
en.sarwar: 13. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from al-Hassan ibn Musa from Ghiyath ibn Kalub from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has narrated from his ancestors
who have said that Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, disliked performing al-Hajj or al-‘Umrah on a camel that ate feces.’” (Fatwa best explains Hadith 12-13 of this Chapter)
